versions.changelog:
- Initial release of meta-autonomous-deep-research as a super-agent skill distilled from autonomous-deep-research.
- Adds self-verification to each workflow step, using reliability checks and redoing outputs below threshold.
- Integrates self-reflection with feedback loop, capturing failure patterns for continuous improvement.
- Enables direct integration into super-agent workflows, supporting perception, planning, execution, verification, reflection, and memory.
- Incorporates adversarial validation to ensure distilled rules are robust and not superficial.
- Supports ongoing self-evolution via meta-evolver, strengthening performance across sessions.
